'''Ni Timor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. He was present along with fellow Kaminoan scientists [[Lac Nor]] and [[Ko Sai/Legends|Ko Sai]] when [[Magister]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] inquired the possibility of [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] a [[Yinchorri/Legends|Yinchorri]].<ref name="DP" />
